title: My Neighborhood
text:
I live in a small neighborhood in the city. There is a park near my house. Many children play there after school. There is also a small shop on the corner.

My neighbors are very friendly. Mrs. Brown lives next door to me. She has a big cat called Tom. On Sundays, we have a picnic in the park.

questions.text: What is the name of the cat?
Why do many children like the park?
options: It is a good place to play
It is far away from the city

questions.text: What kind of people live in the narrator's neighborhood?
options: People who do not know each other

vocabulary.definition: a small area of a town or city where people live
kind and pleasant to other people
a meal eaten outside, often in a park
the place where two streets meet

paragraph_translations: Я живу в невеликому районі міста. Недалеко від мого будинку є парк. Після школи там грає багато дітей. На розі також є невеликий магазин.
Мої сусіди дуже привітні. Пані Браун живе поруч зі мною. У неї є великий кіт на ім'я Том. По неділях ми влаштовуємо пікнік у парку.
